evidence.paraphrase: The paper defines nowcasting as estimating current output and inflation from incomplete, staggered, and revisable information sets.
A parametric dynamic factor state-space model and Kalman filter map a large monthly panel into factors, target projections, and forecast uncertainty under ragged-edge missingness.
Each release changes the information set; the resulting forecast revision is attributed to standardized news and its model-implied weight, separating signal content from release timing.
Release blocks are compared by effects on nowcast level and precision, with recursive real-time timing and hard-versus-soft data distinctions rather than a full-sample fit comparison.

executive_summary: Giannone, Reichlin, and Small reconstruct the real-time U.S. nowcasting problem as an expanding information set with staggered releases and revisions. A dynamic factor/state-space model handles the ragged edge; Kalman filtering produces nowcasts and uncertainty, while forecast revisions are decomposed into release-specific news. The paper therefore supplies both an executable nowcast recipe and a lineage contract for what was knowable at every release time.

method_routes.identification_strategy: predictive state-space measurement and transition system; no structural shock claim
identifying_assumptions: release calendar and vintages are respected

model parameters are estimated only from information available by the forecast origin
method_routes.method_family: dynamic factor state-space nowcast with Kalman filtering
method_routes.sample_definition: vintage-aligned U.S. monthly indicators and quarterly targets at sequential within-quarter forecast origins

method_routes.aggregation_role: explanation layer for the DFM nowcast; never an independent macro conclusion
method_routes.estimand: contribution of each release block to a nowcast revision and uncertainty reduction
method_routes.identification_strategy: accounting decomposition conditional on the fitted state-space model and prior information set
identifying_assumptions: pre-release expectations are model-generated without hindsight
news contributions sum to the model revision
method_routes.sample_definition: each scheduled data release event within the nowcast calendar

questions.question_text: How should current-quarter U.S. GDP and inflation nowcasts be updated and attributed as heterogeneous macro data releases arrive in real time?
